spans.boundary_evidence: ReadOwnBuf and ReadBlock begin at 0x407bae after Cache NQCBuf. SetUpTags returns at 0x407d3e. SCSILoad begins at 0x407d40 and lies outside this module.

changes.change: Restored the earlier NOP before WrBlkCom and omitted the September 1986 TagCont branch target.
changes.evidence: At 0x407bd2 the ROM executes NOP, then loads the FCB pointer and file block number before SetUpTags. The later source skips those loads for volume blocks.

changes.change: Removed the later SCSI-busy deferral path. Restored the branch to RWCont when completion runs before the asynchronous trap returns.
changes.evidence: The asynchronous path starts by loading RWIOComp at 0x407c30. The branch at 0x407c56 targets RWCont at 0x407c62, preserving registers before completion resumes.

changes.change: Restored D4-D7/A4-A6 as the saved completion registers. Removed the later memory-error exception and final condition-code test.
changes.evidence: The MOVEM instructions at 0x407c62 and 0x407c86 use those registers. The error path preserves OffLinErr and maps other errors to IOErr. It returns at 0x407c84 without a final TST. FileMgrPatches retains the earlier register set and dates the later branch and condition-code changes to September 1986.

changes.change: Preserved the original header, applicable history, and surviving comments. Kept inactive debug checks as comments. Added original equates, explicit trap opcodes, and PC-relative label addressing.
changes.evidence: All 402 bytes and 23 labels match. Named Read and Write opcodes distinguish synchronous 0xa002/0xa003 from asynchronous 0xa402/0xa403 operations. The hardware routines beginning at SCSILoad remain outside the reconstructed file-system span.

verification.method: Reconstruction/Tools/verify.py assembled for the 68000, linked at 0x407bae, and compared every emitted byte and all recorded labels against the ROM.
limits: The comparison proves emitted bytes and label positions. It does not execute file operations, disk writes, memory handling, or asynchronous operations.
External routines and trap implementations lie outside this span. Their referenced addresses and opcodes are checked here, but their implementations and runtime dispatch are not.

The original Mac Plus source and historical assembler output remain unavailable. Restored expressions and comments explain the verified ROM behavior; they do not establish the exact original spelling.
